messages:
frank: FYI Marlin customer sent LoRA merge (adapter_marlin_v1). Quick smoke shows date normalization errors (e.g. '03/04/26' -> 'March 4 26' vs expected '2026-03-04'). Need triage.
yasmin: can you attach the merge diff and the eval pack?
frank: diff: models/marlin/adapter_marlin_v1 scale=0.42. eval pack: https://redwood.dev/evals/marlin-dates-quick2026
leo: ran tokenizer checks: ids match. initial thought: token-splitting for slashed dates plus quantization changes token probs.
frank: kicked off quick runs: (1) fp16 base + fp16 lora, (2) int4 base + fp16 lora, (3) int4 base + int4 lora, (4) fp16 base + int4 lora. cmd: ./run_quick --model marlin:adapter_marlin_v1 --quant PROFILE --prompts dates_golden.json --out /tmp/marlin.json
yasmin: add a warmup variant (+8 warm queries) and a token-stabilizer flag test.
ci-bot: Job 94567 queued on pool-dedicated-06. link: https://redwood.dev/jobs/94567
leo: results summary: (1) fp16/fp16: date-format exact 99.6% PASS, (2) int4 base + fp16 lora: 97.0% FAIL (slashes turned into words), (3) int4/int4: 95.4% FAIL, (4) fp16 base + int4 lora: 98.8% borderline.
yasmin: warmup (+8) improved (2) to 98.3% but still below our 99.0% bar. token-stabilizer=true improved int4 cases by ~0.7%.
frank: hypothesis: quantized base kernels shift logits at punctuation boundaries; LoRA in fp16 helps but int4 base introduces symbol-to-word swaps.
leo: proposed mitigations: (a) recommend base=float16 for date-sensitive/legal routes, (b) enable kv_warmup=8 for Marlin model, (c) set token_stabilizer=true in serving for this model, (d) add post-process normalizer for date tokens as temporary patch.
yasmin: i'll add a model catalog note: "marlin-adapter_marlin_v1: prefer base=float16 for date/legal parsing; kv_warmup=8; token_stabilizer=true; postprocess_date_normalizer=true (temp)"
frank: I'll add a smoketest gate: block merges if dates exact-match < 99.0% across quant profiles. Also add matrix test for token_stabilizer flag.
ci-bot: Job 94567 finished. logs: https://redwood.dev/jobs/94567/logs
leo: follow-up: schedule an isolation test loading float kernels with int4 weight blobs to confirm kernel vs quant rounding effect. tagging @yasmin.
yasmin: thanks all, will hold rollout until catalog flags and smoketest are in place. :thumbsup:
